title: Sisi Convenes Cabinet, Governors and Security Chiefs, Urges Better Use of State Resources and Stronger Public Trust
detail: On September 29, 2026, President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi held a broad meeting with PM Mostafa Madbouly, ministers, governors, senior officials and military and police commanders at the Strategic Command headquarters in the New Capital. He called for better use of state resources, stronger public confidence in state institutions and greater efforts to protect domestic stability amid economic and regional challenges.
